title: Undergraduate Summer Research Awards and Summer Student Research Program for Non‑Medical Students
about: Dalhousie University's Faculty of Medicine in Halifax, Canada, accepts applications for its Undergraduate Summer Research Awards and Summer Student Research Program for non-medical students, for summer 2027 research. Applications are due 15 January 2027, 5:00 pm AST.
requirements: At least in the second year of an undergraduate program
Supervisor whose primary appointment is in the Faculty of Medicine
The Summer Student Research Program for non-medical students is aimed at African Nova Scotian, Black and Indigenous undergraduates interested in health research

upskill.name: the EduCut AI Academy catalog
why: No course reached a genuine match: the requirements (year of study, GPA of at least 3.0, a Faculty of Medicine supervisor) and the health research field are not covered by any course objective; the shortlist matched only generic stems ("student", "program", "research"), so the post links to the Academy catalog.
